findings.title: New x-vercel-isr path-rewrite branch has no test
findings.why_it_matters: The branch that restores ISR routing (the regression this PR fixes) and also re-opens a query-param path override gated only by a request header ships with zero test coverage, and no test file changed. The same ISR 404 regression from #15959 slipped through because no test invoked the _isr function; the same can happen again. The existing path-override-security tests call only _render without the x-vercel-isr header, so they pass whether the new branch works, is deleted, or is over-permissive (for example, honoring the param on any request).
findings.suggested_fix: Extend packages/integrations/vercel/test/path-override-security.test.js (reusing loadFunctionModule and the dynamic-routes fixture) with: (1) positive: Request('https://example.com/_isr?x_astro_path=/api/private', {headers: {'x-vercel-isr': '1'}}) returns the /api/private body (or build the isr fixture and load the _isr function); (2) negative: same URL without the header, and with 'x-vercel-isr': '0', still resolves the real URL path; (3) valid middleware secret still takes precedence over the ISR param. Assumption: the dynamic-routes fixture needs ISR enabled or the test targets the isr fixture's _isr function.
evidence: packages/integrations/vercel/test/path-override-security.test.js -- only two tests, both call loadFunctionModule(fixture, '_render') with no x-vercel-isr header
packages/integrations/vercel/test/isr.test.js -- only asserts prerender-config JSON and routes config.json; never invokes the _isr function
PR body: 'No additional test cases added; manual e2e on a test Vercel project.'

residual_risks: The new gate is solely request.headers.get('x-vercel-isr') === '1', which the entrypoint does not authenticate; whether an external client can spoof it on the _render function depends on Vercel platform header stripping, which could not be verified here. No test pins the assumption.
testing_gaps: No test covers precedence when both a valid middleware secret and x-vercel-isr: 1 are present.
No test checks that an x-vercel-isr value other than '1' (e.g. 'true', '0') is rejected.
